exposure: elements of an interview (e.g., irregular menstruations, pain increasing during menstruation)
cohort: The study included 148 reproductive-age women experiencing chronic pelvic pain who underwent laparoscopy.
finding: Irregular menstruations with increasing pain showed the best sensitivity, specificity, positive predictive value, and negative predictive value for diagnosing endometriosis.
cross-section timing: At the time of diagnosis for chronic pelvic pain, prior to and during laparoscopy.
